messages:
Elliot H: morning! I'm on my first week and can view the Notion onboarding docs but can't edit. Where are the official templates stored and what's the fastest way to get edit rights?
Maya D: welcome Elliot :tada: Official templates live in the shared workspace 'Redwood Docs' > Templates > Onboarding. We keep Eng/PM/Ops variants there.
Elliot H: cool — I can open the folder but pages say 'Can view'. The request button goes to admins; is there a quicker route if I need to update the Eng first-week checklist now?
Maya D: two quick options: 1) Duplicate the template into your personal workspace and start a draft, then submit via docs-bot to create a contribution PR. 2) Fill IT access form to join the Docs Editors SSO group for write rights across team pages.
Taylor (IT): Hi Elliot  fastest is the IT form: https://forms.redwood.internal/it-access (choose Notion > Contributor). Add your manager for approval to speed it up. Typical turnaround 15-45 minutes.
Elliot H: if I do the duplicate+docs-bot flow, does the bot keep subpages and images?
Maya D: yes if you choose 'Duplicate with subpages'. Images are included in the PR most of the time; embeds (Figma/Loom) sometimes need re-linking. When you invite docs-bot, include a short PR note and mention which regional copies to update.
Docs Bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist includes "Notion edit access". Reply with "manager: NAME" to auto-notify Docs and IT for faster processing.
Elliot H: manager: Maya D
Maya D: approved. Once IT adds you to Docs Editors I'll flip page-level permissions if needed. Naming note: please prefix templates with "[SWE] -" or "[PM] -" so search and permissions stay tidy.
Elliot H: thanks all — submitted the IT form and duplicated the Eng checklist. I'll invite docs-bot after I tidy my draft. Appreciate the quick help!
